description: Sign-in hardening and reduced user information exposure. These policies are not intended to speed up sign-in.

policies.name: Do Not Display Last Signed-in User
policies.description: Hides the last signed-in username from the Windows sign-in screen; users must enter their username.

policies.name: Do Not Enumerate Local Users on Domain-Joined Computers
policies.description: Prevents listing local accounts on domain-joined computers at sign-in; may not affect standalone PCs.

policies.name: Require Ctrl+Alt+Delete for Interactive Sign-in
policies.description: Requires Ctrl+Alt+Delete before signing in where supported; can affect convenience and accessibility.
